text:
alex: Postmortem posted for the "missing spans + aggregation drift" incident. Short summary: an off-by-one in ETL windowing + schema evolution of service_x caused ~1.5% span loss and a daily aggregation skew for a subset of tenants. Pls use this thread for owners/timelines.

ops-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1906789012 (ops doc)

julia: I can take the ETL windowing fix and a quick perf validation. Plan: patch to fix inclusive/exclusive boundary, add deterministic batching, add unit tests for edge windows. ETA: PR by Fri EOD, canary early next week.

samir: I'll own the aggregation schema compatibility issue and backfill plan. Work: add schema guards, cover join-key evolution in tests, and compute safe backfill ranges. ETA: initial tests by Tue.

toni: I'll update runbooks and draft customer comms. Also want a checklist for backfill safety checks (checksum, idempotency, monitoring).

alex: Can we define backfill scope now? rough numbers: ~4 hours of data across 3 tenants, ~500k spans total. Need runtime estimate and whether to throttle.

samir: Backfill approach: reprocess per-tenant with rate cap. Command we used previously: `./bin/reprocess --start 2026-03-22T04:00Z --end 2026-03-22T08:00Z --tenant <id> --rate 2000/s --dry-run` then remove dry-run. Expect ~1h per tenant with rate cap. Recommend canary tenant only first.

julia: local unit tests green. Patch changes: fix window logic (right-exclusive -> left-inclusive), add fixed-seed jitter for deterministic batching, and enforce max batch size. PR: https://github.com/redwood/etl/pull/427 cc @samir for backfill implications.

samir: I added an aggregation integrity test that compares pre/post backfill checksums in staging. Also created metric `agg.reconciliation.mismatch` and a small dashboard tile. Alert: >0 mismatches on daily job -> page. Dash: https://dashboards.internal/d/agg/1906789012

toni: Runbook snippet added: "If agg.reconciliation.mismatch or dropped_spans > 0.2%: pause ingestion, notify SRE, run checksum verification, perform backfill canary." Comms draft uploaded: https://docs.internal/incident-comms/1906789012

alex: Meeting Thurs 09:30 to review PR, canary plan, and backfill checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Thu 09:30 1 mar 2026 1 meeting created and invites sent.

julia: Deploying canary to 5% now. Watching CPU, memory, and span throughput. Posting perf snippet in meeting notes channel.

samir: Canary signals look good so far. dropped_spans metric fell from ~1.5% -> 0.03% in canary tenant. Aggregation reconciliation test passed on canary sample.

toni: Updated remediation tracker: https://docs.internal/remediation-tracker with owners and ETA. Assigned items: ETL fix -> julia (PR 427), Aggregation tests + schema guard -> samir (ticket INF-919), Runbook & comms -> toni. Target close date 2026-03-28.

alex: Agreed. Samir please post exact backfill command and a checksum sample after you run the canary backfill.

samir: Will run canary backfill tomorrow on tenant-alpha. Will post logs + checksums here. For safety added a pre-check: if recon mismatch increases after canary, abort full run.

julia: After canary completes I'll open a short blameless summary and mark follow-ups in the postmortem doc.

alex: Thanks all. Noting recurrence: this is the third time windowing jitter caused noise in ETL over 12 months. Recommend adding a monthly regression smoke test to CI that simulates tail traffic.

samir: Added INF-920 to track monthly smoke job and long-term fix to make join keys forward/backward compatible.

toni: Closing loop: once backfill canary is verified and PR merged, we'll schedule full backfill and then close incident; remaining infra items tracked as follow-ups.

ops-bot: Incident follow-up checklist updated in ops tracker."
